findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Gate. The added Developer, Drawer, Insights, Item, Main, Manager and Releases artboards (`.dc.html` and `.png`), plus `support.js`, are outside SERVER's allowed paths. The local server does not use them; the later screen tasks use these design references. Their inclusion makes this part exceed its assigned scope.
findings.title: Gate: remove design artboards from the SERVER change

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `watched()` fingerprints Git refs, Git-directory records and lanes, but omits working-tree `.factory` state, plans and `forge.toml`. The derivation reads uncommitted state from worktrees (`board.py:981-997`) and local plan text (`story.py:597`). While a worker edits an open story before committing, `/board.json` returns the old snapshot and `/events` stays quiet because `now()` sees unchanged inputs.
findings.title: Watch working-tree inputs before serving the cached snapshot

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Scale. Every row key includes `tips.get(landed)`, so merging one fix into main rebuilds every active story and fix row even when their inputs have not changed. The proof test changes only a fix-branch tip, so it misses this normal merge path. On the stated repository, even a one-item rebuild already takes about seven seconds; rebuilding all rows makes the promised responsive live refresh worse as the board grows.
findings.title: An unrelated main commit invalidates every cached item row

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 3, Harm 2
The placeholder page contains only a title and a link to `board.json`; it has no event listener or polling, so an open page does not refresh itself. The approved task split assigns the real page shell and its browser test to SHELL, which must complete this clause of Done-when item 1.
findings.title: Later: SHELL must make the page refresh by itself
